name: Rhubarb & Blood Orange Overnight Oats
steps: Chuck the oats into a bowl with the milk, Greek yoghurt, maple syrup and a pinch of salt. Stir to combine, then cover and chill in the fridge overnight.
Peel one of the blood oranges, then slice the peel into thin strips. Segment both oranges, collecting any juice that drips out.

Cut the rhubarb into 3cm pieces then add to a pan and cover with 200ml water and juice of the blood oranges and sugar. Bring to a very gentle simmer and cook for 6 mins, then remove from the heat. 
Strain the the rhubarb into a bowl and then pop the juice back on the stove over a medium heat, simmering and reducing until its thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Cool and pour back over the rhubarb, then add in the orange segments.

Mix the oats in a bowl with the walnuts, maple syrup, fennel seeds and a pinch of salt. Pop on a baking dray and drizle over the coconut oil and slide into the oven. 
After for 10 mins, add the orange peel and return the tray into the oven for another 5 mins. Remove and cool.

Fill glasses or Tupperware containers with the oats then top with the rhubarb compote before scattering with granola.
If making ahead it's best to keep the granola separate and add it in the morning so it keeps its crunch. These will keep for up to 3 days in the fridge.

pt.name: Aveia Noturna de Ruibarbo e Laranja Sanguínea
steps: Coloque a aveia numa tigela com o leite, o iogurte grego, o xarope de ácer e uma pitada de sal. Misture, tape e leve ao frigorífico de um dia para o outro.
Descasque uma das laranjas sanguíneas e corte a casca em tiras finas. Segmente ambas as laranjas, recolhendo o sumo que escorrer.

Corte o ruibarbo em pedaços de 3 cm e junte numa panela com 200 ml de água, o sumo das laranjas e o açúcar. Leve a um lume muito suave e cozinhe 6 min, depois retire do lume. Coe o ruibarbo para uma tigela e volte a colocar o sumo no fogão em lume médio, reduzindo até cobrir as costas de uma colher. Deixe arrefecer e verta sobre o ruibarbo, depois junte os gomos de laranja.

Misture a aveia numa tigela com as nozes, o xarope de ácer, as sementes de funcho e uma pitada de sal. Coloque num tabuleiro, regue com o óleo de coco e leve ao forno. Após 10 min, adicione a casca de laranja e volte ao forno mais 5 min. Retire e deixe arrefecer.

Encha copos ou recipientes com a aveia, cubra com o compote de ruibarbo e polvilhe com a granola. Se preparar com antecedência, guarde a granola separada e adicione de manhã para manter a textura. Conserva-se até 3 dias no frigorífico.
